summary.text: Dennis Degenhardt is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 58, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Bernie Newman in a race with no incumbent.
He was also the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Dennis Degenhardt advanced from the Democratic primary for Assembly District 58 on August 14, 2018, and lost the November 6, 2018 general election to incumbent Republican Rick Gundrum, 71.0 percent to 29.0 percent.
He advanced from the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary in an uncontested race.
